name: Ibn Faḍlān's embassy to the Volga Bulgars
summary: Aḥmad ibn Faḍlān serves as secretary on an Abbasid embassy (dispatched by caliph al-Muqtadir in 921) to the king of the Volga Bulgars, who had requested Islamic missionaries and an Abbasid alliance against the Khazars. His Risāla survives in a unique Mashhad manuscript; it contains the earliest detailed first-hand Arabic description of the Rus' on the Volga, including the famous report of a Rus' ship-burial.

_quarry.structural_significance: Single most-cited Arabic source on 10th-century steppe and Volga-trade peoples; the only contemporary eyewitness of the Rus' before they became the dominant power on the eastern European waterways.
